sources.articleTitle: TVK's VS Babu, who defeated MK Stalin, dies after 71-day hospitalisation
TVK MLA V.S. Babu, who defeated M.K. Stalin in Kolathur, passes away

headline: TVK MLA V.S. Babu Who Defeated M.K. Stalin Passes Away In Chennai
metaDescription: V.S. Babu, the TVK MLA from Kolathur known for defeating M.K. Stalin in the 2026 assembly election, has died following a prolonged respiratory illness.
aiSummaryBullets: TVK legislator V.S. Babu died at MGM Healthcare in Chennai after a 71-day hospitalization.
Medical reports indicate the MLA suffered from respiratory complications that ultimately resulted in cardiac arrest.
Babu was a prominent political figure who won the Kolathur assembly seat against M.K. Stalin during the 2026 state elections.
aiContextParagraph: V.S. Babu, an elected member of the legislative assembly representing the TVK party in Kolathur, passed away on November 19, 2026. According to reports, the politician had been undergoing medical treatment at MGM Healthcare in Chennai for more than two months. The cause of death has been identified as cardiac arrest following a 71-day struggle with ongoing respiratory issues. The MLA gained significant political recognition after defeating M.K. Stalin in the 2026 Assembly election. Despite receiving extensive care throughout his extended stay at the medical facility, his condition reportedly worsened until his passing. His death marks a significant shift in local representation, given his victory against a high-profile political opponent in the most recent legislative cycle. The news of his passing has been confirmed by multiple media outlets following reports from the healthcare institution where he was treated.
whyItIsViral: This story is trending due to strong public search interest regarding the late legislator and coverage by two independent national outlets.
